name: China Masters
stakes: This Super 750 event is a key opportunity for India's shuttlers to gain momentum, secure vital ranking points, and test their mettle against the world's best ahead of the upcoming BWF World Championships.
summary:
India's top badminton contingent heads into the China Masters, a Super 750 event, looking to build crucial momentum ahead of the BWF World Championships. While the draw for Shenzhen is yet to be revealed, eyes will be on the seeded Men's Doubles pair of **Satwiksairaj Rankireddy & Chirag Shetty**, who consistently challenge for titles. Their world rank of 5 positions them as strong contenders.

In singles, **PV Sindhu** (world No. 9) continues her quest to return to peak form, while **Lakshya Sen** (world No. 14) aims for a deep run to solidify his standing among the elite. Veteran **HS Prannoy**, despite his current world No. 24 ranking, has expressed a strong desire to fight his way back into the top 10, indicating his fierce competitive spirit. The tournament offers a valuable platform for these players to fine-tune their game and collect vital ranking points.

Rising Women's Doubles pair **Treesa Jolly & Gayatri Gopichand** (world No. 16) and Mixed Doubles duo **Dhruv Kapila & Tanisha Crasto** (world No. 18) will also be eager to make their mark against strong international competition, continuing their development on the Super Series circuit. Young **Malvika Bansod** rounds out the singles contingent, gaining valuable experience at this level.
